form.label: AD – Authentication Anomalies & Bulk Accounts
form.description: Password changes outside working hours, user account lockouts, bulk user creation/deletion, and short-lived accounts.

input.label: 🔍 Global Search Filter
input.placeholder: Filter all panels (e.g., username, group name)

div.style: background: #fbe9e7; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 4px; border-left: 4px solid #BF360C; margin-bottom: 8px;
div.p: Detects password changes outside working hours and user account lockouts — key indicators of compromised accounts.

search.query:
`DC-index` (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR source="WinEventLog:Security") ( EventCode IN (4624, 4768, 4769) AND src=* AND NOT src IN ("-", "::1", "0.0.0.0", "127.0.0.1") ) [ search `DC-index` (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR source="WinEventLog:Security") EventCode IN (627, 628, 4723, 4724, 4794) | dedup ComputerName Subject_Account_Name | table ComputerName Subject_Account_Name | rename Subject_Account_Name AS user ] | search $search_filter|s$ | eval date_wday = strftime(_time, "%A") | eval date_hour = tonumber(strftime(_time, "%H")) | eval WorkingHours = case( date_wday IN ("Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday") AND date_hour >= 7 AND date_hour < 17, "Working", 1=1, "Outside" ) | search WorkingHours="Outside" | eval EventType = "Logon" | table _time ComputerName Subject_Account_Name src EventCode WorkingHours EventType
| append [ search `DC-index` (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR source="WinEventLog:Security") EventCode IN (627, 628, 4723, 4724, 4794) | search $search_filter|s$ | eval date_wday = strftime(_time, "%A") | eval date_hour = tonumber(strftime(_time, "%H")) | eval WorkingHours = case( date_wday IN ("Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday") AND date_hour >= 7 AND date_hour < 17, "Working", 1=1, "Outside") | search WorkingHours="Outside" | eval Subject_Account_Name = Account_Name | eval TargetUser = coalesce(TargetAccountName, AccountName, user) | eval ComputerName = ComputerName | eval TargetDomain = coalesce(TargetAccountDomain, AccountDomain) | eval Action = case( EventCode IN (4723, 4724), "Password Change/Reset", EventCode=4794, "DSRM Password Reset", EventCode IN (627, 628), "Password Change (Legacy)" ) | eval EventType = "PasswordChange" | table _time ComputerName Subject_Account_Name TargetUser TargetDomain EventCode Action WorkingHours EventType ]
| sort 0 _time
| eventstats values(src) as ProbableSources by ComputerName Subject_Account_Name
| where EventType="PasswordChange"
| eval Target_User = TargetUser | eval Actor = Subject_Account_Name | eval Actor_User_Domain = "Domain" | eval Source_Computer = mvindex(ProbableSources, 0) | eval Source_Computer = if(isnull(Source_Computer), ComputerName, Source_Computer)
| table _time Target_User Actor Source_Computer EventCode Action Actor_User_Domain WorkingHours | rename Target_User AS "Target User", Actor AS "Actor", Source_Computer AS "Probable Sources", Actor_User_Domain AS "Actor User Domain" | sort - _time

`DC-index` (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR source="WinEventLog:Security") EventCode=4740 | search $search_filter|s$ | eval Account_Name = mvfilter(NOT match(Account_Name, "\$")) | search Account_Name=* | eval date_wday = strftime(_time, "%A") | eval date_hour = tonumber(strftime(_time, "%H")) | eval WorkingHours = case(date_wday IN ("Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday") AND date_hour >= 7 AND date_hour < 17, "Working", 1=1, "Outside") | table _time ComputerName Account_Domain Account_Name Caller_Computer_Name WorkingHours | rename ComputerName AS "Domain_Controller", Account_Domain AS "User_Domain", Account_Name AS "User_Name", Caller_Computer_Name AS "Source_Computer_Name" | fillnull value="-" Source_Computer_Name | sort - _time

div.style: background: #f3e5f5; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 4px; border-left: 4px solid #6A1B9A; margin-bottom: 8px;
div.p: Detects mass user account creation/deletion and accounts created and deleted quickly — indicators of automated attacks or identity management issues.

search.query:
`DC-index` (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR source="WinEventLog:Security") EventCode IN (4720, 4726) | rex field=Message max_match=0 "(?m)^[ \t]*Account Name:[ \t]*(?<AccountNames>[^\r\n]+)" | rex field=Message max_match=0 "(?m)^[ \t]*Account Domain:[ \t]*(?<AccountDomains>[^\r\n]+)" | rex field=Message "(?m)^[ \t]*Logon ID:[ \t]*(?<Logon_ID>[^\r\n]+)" | eval AdminUser = mvindex(AccountNames, 0) | eval AdminDomain = mvindex(AccountDomains, 0) | eval TargetUser = mvindex(AccountNames, 1) | eval TargetDomain = mvindex(AccountDomains, 1) | eval admin_logonID = Logon_ID | where isnotnull(TargetUser) | where NOT match(TargetUser, "\$$") AND NOT match(AdminUser, "\$$") | where TargetUser != AdminUser
| eval Action = if(EventCode=4720, "Created", "Deleted") | bin _time span=1h | stats count as EventCount values(TargetUser) as Target_Users values(ComputerName) as Computers min(_time) as FirstEvent max(_time) as LastEvent by _time AdminUser AdminDomain Action
| where EventCount >= 4
| eval Target_User_List = mvjoin(mvdedup(Target_Users), ", ") | eval Computers = mvjoin(Computers, ", ") | eval FirstEvent = strftime(FirstEvent, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval LastEvent = strftime(LastEvent, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval Severity = case( EventCount >= 50, "Critical", EventCount >= 20, "High", EventCount >= 10, "Medium", 1=1, "Low")
| table _time, AdminUser, AdminDomain, Action, EventCount, Severity, FirstEvent, LastEvent, Target_User_List, Computers
| rename _time as "Hour Bucket", AdminUser as "Administrator", AdminDomain as "Admin Domain", Action as "Action", EventCount as "Number of Accounts", Severity as "Severity", FirstEvent as "First Event", LastEvent as "Last Event", Target_User_List as "Target Users", Computers as "Domain Controllers"
| sort - "Number of Accounts"

`DC-index` (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR source="WinEventLog:Security") EventCode IN (4720, 4726) | rex field=Message max_match=0 "(?m)^[ \t]*Account Name:[ \t]*(?<AccountNames>[^\r\n]+)" | eval AdminUser = mvindex(AccountNames, 0) | eval TargetUser = mvindex(AccountNames, 1) | where isnotnull(TargetUser) | where NOT match(TargetUser, "\$$") AND NOT match(AdminUser, "\$$") | where TargetUser != AdminUser | eval CreateTime = if(EventCode=4720, _time, null()) | eval DeleteTime = if(EventCode=4726, _time, null()) | stats min(CreateTime) as CreateTime max(DeleteTime) as DeleteTime count(eval(EventCode=4720)) as CreateEvents count(eval(EventCode=4726)) as DeleteEvents values(ComputerName) as Computers values(AdminUser) as Admins dc(AdminUser) as AdminCount by TargetUser | where isnotnull(CreateTime) AND isnotnull(DeleteTime) | where CreateTime <= DeleteTime | eval Lifespan = DeleteTime - CreateTime | where Lifespan < 48800 | eval CreateTime = strftime(CreateTime, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval DeleteTime = strftime(DeleteTime, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval Lifespan_Human = tostring(Lifespan, "duration") | eval Severity = case( Lifespan < 300, "Critical", Lifespan < 3600, "High", Lifespan < 24400, "Medium", 1=1, "Low") | eval Admins = mvjoin(mvdedup(Admins), ", ") | eval Computers = mvjoin(mvdedup(Computers), ", ")
| table TargetUser, CreateTime, DeleteTime, Lifespan, Lifespan_Human, Severity, Admins, AdminCount, Computers, CreateEvents, DeleteEvents
| rename TargetUser as "User Account", CreateTime as "Created At", DeleteTime as "Deleted At", Lifespan as "Lifespan (s)", Lifespan_Human as "Lifespan", Severity as "Severity", Admins as "Administrators", AdminCount as "Admin Count", Computers as "Domain Controllers", CreateEvents as "# Create Events", DeleteEvents as "# Delete Events"
| sort Lifespan
